class Account {

  Int balance;

  Account(Int start) {
    this.balance = start;
  }

  Int deposit(Int amount) {
    this.balance = this.balance + amount;
    return this.balance;
  }

  static dynamic run() {
    var a = Account(100);
    print('bal=' + a.deposit(50));
    try {
      throw 'overdraft';
    } catch (String e) {
      print('caught=$e');
    }
  }

}
